subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public bare-reset greeting contract should OpenClaw support across auto-reply and Gateway: acknowledgement-only, startup/model greeting, suppressible greeting, cheaper greeting model routing, prompt customization, or one typed policy that covers these modes?
rationale: Current shipped code and docs encode cheap acknowledgement-only bare resets, while this issue and related reports ask for restore/suppress/model-routing behavior; choosing the contract changes session semantics, token cost, and provider routing.

options.title: Choose One Typed Reset Policy
options.body: Define a single policy shape that covers acknowledgement-only, startup-turn, suppress, prompt customization, and optional model override semantics, then implement it consistently across source, docs, schema, and tests.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Text Only
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45501 own reset prompt wording while keeping this broader model/suppress issue open for a later policy decision.

options.title: Keep Ack-Only As Direction
options.body: Document bare reset acknowledgement as intentional, close or narrow restore/suppress/model-routing requests, and direct users to explicit `/new <message>` or a future startup-turn command.

recommendation.title: Choose One Typed Reset Policy
recommendation.body: Define a single policy shape that covers acknowledgement-only, startup-turn, suppress, prompt customization, and optional model override semantics, then implement it consistently across source, docs, schema, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is tied to the current acknowledgement-only reset contract and has already reviewed this issue's remaining product decision.
